name: Flair USA

about:
Flair Flexible Packaging, operating as Flair USA, is headquartered in Appleton, Wisconsin. The company was founded in 1992 and remains privately held and family-owned. It began as a flexible packaging manufacturer and has grown into a vertically integrated operation with facilities across North America and Asia.

The company produces flexible packaging films, pouches, and bags through extrusion, converting, flexographic printing (up to 10 colors), solventless lamination, and rotogravure printing. Its Appleton site houses an extrusion facility, a converting facility, an analytical lab, and an application lab. A 2023 expansion in Calgary, Alberta added 35,000 square feet of production space for printing and lamination. The firm offers both custom-engineered structures — including coextruded and laminated films for hot-fill, high-pressure processing, and retort applications — and a stock program of unprinted rollstock, lidding, and vacuum pouches.

Flair serves food and non-food markets such as meat and poultry, seafood, cheese and dairy, prepared foods, snacks and sweets, baby food, grains and spices, fruits and vegetables, coffee and tea, liquids and spreads, pet care, and foodservice. Customers range from national brands to regional processors seeking tailored barrier performance, shelf-life extension, and sustainable formats.

The company emphasizes vertical integration as a differentiator, controlling quality from resin extrusion through final conversion. It highlights its FSSC 22000-certified food safety system, FDA/USDA/CFIA compliance, and collaborative development model that includes factory acceptance testing, shelf-life validation, and on-site engineering support.
